scene: You step off the clanking bridge crawler onto bustling Gear Bridge.
picture: Side-view pixel art along a steel deck. Far left sits a steaming soup cart. Beside it rests the empty, tracked bridge crawler. Centre stands the bearded player with his prosthetic leg, next to a crowded tool stall. Right of him, a massive turning brass gear churns. Far right waits a yellow gear tram with its door open.
shown: a steaming noodle soup cart with hanging ladles on the far left
a repair stall overflowing with copper wrenches in the centre
a yellow mechanical tram with an open door on the far right

variants.scene: Sunset gleams off giant cogs as you arrive on the lively bridge.
Steam and street chatter drift past as you wonder where {quest} might be.
Lanterns glow softly along the noisy iron platform under the dusky purple sky.
